name: cloudtrail
description: CloudTrail This is the CloudTrail API Reference.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a trail, event data store, dashboard, or channel, up to a limit of 50.

subcommands.name: cancel-query
subcommands.description: Cancels a query if the query is not in a terminated state, such as CANCELLED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, or FINISHED.

subcommands.name: create-channel
subcommands.description: Creates a channel for CloudTrail to ingest events from a partner or external source.

subcommands.name: create-dashboard
subcommands.description: Creates a custom dashboard or the Highlights dashboard.

subcommands.name: create-event-data-store
subcommands.description: Creates a new event data store.

subcommands.name: create-subscription
subcommands.description: Creates and configures the AWS resources necessary to use CloudTrail, creates a trail using those resources, and turns on logging.

subcommands.name: create-trail
subcommands.description: Creates a trail that specifies the settings for delivery of log data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: delete-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes a channel.

subcommands.name: delete-dashboard
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified dashboard.

subcommands.name: delete-event-data-store
subcommands.description: Disables the event data store specified by EventDataStore, which accepts an event data store ARN.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource-based policy attached to the CloudTrail event data store, dashboard, or channel.

subcommands.name: delete-trail
subcommands.description: Deletes a trail.

subcommands.name: deregister-organization-delegated-admin
subcommands.description: Removes CloudTrail delegated administrator permissions from a member account in an organization.

subcommands.name: describe-query
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about a query, including query run time in milliseconds, number of events scanned and matched, and query status.

subcommands.name: describe-trails
subcommands.description: Retrieves settings for one or more trails associated with the current Region for your account.

subcommands.name: disable-federation
subcommands.description: Disables Lake query federation on the specified event data store.

subcommands.name: enable-federation
subcommands.description: Enables Lake query federation on the specified event data store.

subcommands.name: generate-query
subcommands.description: Generates a query from a natural language prompt.

subcommands.name: get-channel
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific channel.

subcommands.name: get-dashboard
subcommands.description: Returns the specified dashboard.

subcommands.name: get-event-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current event configuration settings for the specified event data store or trail.

subcommands.name: get-event-data-store
subcommands.description: Returns information about an event data store specified as either an ARN or the ID portion of the ARN.

subcommands.name: get-event-selectors
subcommands.description: Describes the settings for the event selectors that you configured for your trail.

subcommands.name: get-import
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific import.

subcommands.name: get-insight-selectors
subcommands.description: Describes the settings for the Insights event selectors that you configured for your trail or event data store.

subcommands.name: get-query-results
subcommands.description: Gets event data results of a query.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the JSON text of the resource-based policy document attached to the CloudTrail event data store, dashboard, or channel.

subcommands.name: get-trail
subcommands.description: Returns settings information for a specified trail.

subcommands.name: get-trail-status
subcommands.description: Returns a JSON-formatted list of information about the specified trail.

subcommands.name: list-channels
subcommands.description: Lists the channels in the current account, and their source names.

subcommands.name: list-dashboards
subcommands.description: Returns information about all dashboards in the account, in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-event-data-stores
subcommands.description: Returns information about all event data stores in the account, in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-import-failures
subcommands.description: Returns a list of failures for the specified import.

subcommands.name: list-imports
subcommands.description: Returns information on all imports, or a select set of imports by ImportStatus or Destination.

subcommands.name: list-insights-data
subcommands.description: Returns Insights events generated on a trail that logs data events.

subcommands.name: list-insights-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns Insights metrics data for trails that have enabled Insights.

subcommands.name: list-public-keys
subcommands.description: Returns all public keys whose private keys were used to sign the digest files within the specified time range.

subcommands.name: list-queries
subcommands.description: Returns a list of queries and query statuses for the past seven days.

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified trails, event data stores, dashboards, or channels in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-trails
subcommands.description: Lists trails that are in the current account.

subcommands.name: lookup-events
subcommands.description: Looks up management events or CloudTrail Insights events that are captured by CloudTrail.

subcommands.name: put-event-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the event configuration settings for the specified event data store or trail.

subcommands.name: put-event-selectors
subcommands.description: Configures event selectors (also referred to as basic event selectors) or advanced event selectors for your trail.

subcommands.name: put-insight-selectors
subcommands.description: Lets you enable Insights event logging on specific event categories by specifying the Insights selectors that you want to enable on an existing trail or event data store.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based permission policy to a CloudTrail event data store, dashboard, or channel.

subcommands.name: register-organization-delegated-admin
subcommands.description: Registers an organization’s member account as the CloudTrail delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from a trail, event data store, dashboard, or channel.

subcommands.name: restore-event-data-store
subcommands.description: Restores a deleted event data store specified by EventDataStore, which accepts an event data store ARN.

subcommands.name: search-sample-queries
subcommands.description: Searches sample queries and returns a list of sample queries that are sorted by relevance.

subcommands.name: start-dashboard-refresh
subcommands.description: Starts a refresh of the specified dashboard.

subcommands.name: start-event-data-store-ingestion
subcommands.description: Starts the ingestion of live events on an event data store specified as either an ARN or the ID portion of the ARN.

subcommands.name: start-import
subcommands.description: Starts an import of logged trail events from a source S3 bucket to a destination event data store.

subcommands.name: start-logging
subcommands.description: Starts the recording of Amazon Web Services API calls and log file delivery for a trail.

subcommands.name: start-query
subcommands.description: Starts a CloudTrail Lake query.

subcommands.name: stop-event-data-store-ingestion
subcommands.description: Stops the ingestion of live events on an event data store specified as either an ARN or the ID portion of the ARN.

subcommands.name: stop-import
subcommands.description: Stops a specified import.

subcommands.name: stop-logging
subcommands.description: Suspends the recording of Amazon Web Services API calls and log file delivery for the specified trail.

subcommands.name: update-channel
subcommands.description: Updates a channel specified by a required channel ARN or UUID.

subcommands.name: update-dashboard
subcommands.description: Updates the specified dashboard.

subcommands.name: update-event-data-store
subcommands.description: Updates an event data store.

subcommands.name: update-subscription
subcommands.description: Updates any of the trail configuration settings, and creates and configures any new AWS resources specified.

subcommands.name: update-trail
subcommands.description: Updates trail settings that control what events you are logging, and how to handle log files.

subcommands.name: validate-logs
subcommands.description: Validates CloudTrail logs for a given period of time.
